entities.summary: Francis Parker Shepard was an American sedimentologist most associated with his studies of submarine canyons and seafloor currents around continental shelves and slopes. Francis Parker Shepard was a scientists & inventors from Marblehead (1897-05-10, Marblehead–1985-04-25). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
